name: Xiangyang Mahjong
description: Xiangyang Mahjong is a Hubei regional Mahjong variant associated with Xiangyang play communities. It keeps the familiar Mahjong draw-discard structure with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while the table profile defines specific scoring and validity conventions.

overview.description: Xiangyang Mahjong is a Hubei regional Mahjong variant associated with Xiangyang play communities. It keeps the familiar Mahjong draw-discard structure with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while the table profile defines specific scoring and validity conventions.

history.origins: Xiangyang Mahjong developed as a regional table profile within Chinese Mahjong traditions through repeated community play in Hubei.
timeline: 20th century: local profiles spread through home and social play.
Modern era: commonly used profiles appear in documented rulesets.
history.cultural: It is played socially with agreed local scoring profiles, often emphasizing familiar community conventions.
history.evolution: The shared Mahjong hand structure remains stable while local table conventions shape scoring and what wins are considered valid.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and discards first.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand that satisfies the active Xiangyang scoring profile.
rules.gameplay: Players draw one tile and discard one tile in turn. Discards may be claimed for legal melds when claim rules permit. A player wins when their tiles form a complete hand and the scoring profile accepts the win.
keyRules: Default loop is draw then discard.
Claims must be legal and follow priority restrictions.
Winning requires a complete 14-tile hand and profile-accepted validity.

strategy.basic: Keep efficient hand shape and avoid discarding tiles that are scarce or obviously needed by opponents.
strategy.intermediate: Track visible discards and meld direction to select safer discards under threat.
strategy.advanced: Profile-aware play balances speed, defense, and value as the wall shortens.
tips: Prefer wider waits when completion speed matters.
Shift to defense when opponents reveal strong single-suit commitment.
